text:
tori_leadcsm: Heads-up: Meridian Health showing renewal at-risk. Usage steady for some features but adoption stalled on scheduled reports and alerting. I want a short "keepalive + graceful downgrade" play we can run next 2 weeks.

ben_ops: Quick inventory: their plan has 3 reserved GPUs, scheduled-reporting relies on the reporting-worker pool. If we scale down to 1 GPU they lose real-time reports but can keep daily exports. We can provide an interim "report-lite" service with daily rollups.

nina_csm: Proposed save plan: 1) 30-min health call to highlight value, 2) enable report-lite + walkthrough, 3) offer a two-week trial of the scheduled-reporting add-on at no cost if they hit 3 report runs and 1 alert triggered. If not met, offer downgrade path preserving exports.

ash_support: Noted a flaky webhook delivery to Meridian (last 48h). Sample error: `POST /webhook/meridian 503 Service Unavailable`. Filed as SUP-2211. Might be scaring their integrators.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-02-18T09:12:02Z to reporting-worker succeeded (rev=2026.2.18.9).

ben_ops: Operationally we can create a downgrade pack: - keep S3 export bucket active for 60 days, - provide CSV snapshots on request, - grant read-only API tokens for exports. Downgrade will move them to "lite" ingestion with 1-2 minute delay.

nina_csm: Messaging script for call: "We want to ensure your team keeps access to critical reports. We can set up a short remediation call this week, activate report-lite, and offer a short trial of scheduled-reporting. If you prefer a subscription change, we'll migrate you to a lighter plan while preserving exports and access for 60 days."

tori_leadcsm: Great. Action owners: nina -> run call invite + agenda, ben -> prepare downgrade pack and confirm S3 retention, ash -> triage SUP-2211 and share ETA, tori -> draft credit language and approval with finance.

nina_csm: I'll schedule a 30m call for Wed and include a short adoption checklist.

ash_support: SUP-2211 root cause identified: webhook retry loop hitting rate-limiter on their side. Reached out with suggested backoff and sample code.

tori_leadcsm: Keep updates here. If we get a 'downgrade' decision, we'll follow the prepared downgrade flow and include an opt-in archival offer.

ben_ops: Uploaded downgrade checklist to /shared/cs/downgrades/meridian-check.json and set retention policy.

nina_csm: Call scheduled. Will update after notes.

tori_leadcsm: Thanks team. Quick note to keep message short in-thread. :sparkles:
